r: arjuna uvAca evaM satatayuktA ye BaktAstvAM paryupAsate. yecApyakzaramavyaktaM tezAM ke yogavittamAH..12.1..
SrI BagavAnuvAca mayyAveSya mano ye mAM nityayuktA upAsate. SradDayA parayopetAste me yuktatamA matAH..12.2..
ye tvakzaramanirdeSyamavyaktaM paryupAsate. sarvatragamacintyaM ca kUwasTamacalaM Druvam..12.3..
saMniyamyendriyagrAmaM sarvatra samabudDayaH. te prApnuvanti mAmeva sarvaBUtahite ratAH..12.4..
kleSo'DikatarastezAmavyaktAsaktacetasAm. avyaktA hi gatirduHKaM dehavadBiravApyate..12.5..
ye tu sarvARi karmARi mayi saMnyasya matparAH. ananyenEva yogena mAM DyAyanta upAsate..12.6..
tezAmahaM samudDartA mftyusaMsArasAgarAt. BavAmi nacirAtpArTa mayyAveSitacetasAm..12.7..
mayyeva mana ADatsva mayi budDiM niveSaya. nivasizyasi mayyeva ata UrDvaM na saMSayaH..12.8..
aTa cittaM samADAtuM na Saknozi mayi sTiram. aByAsayogena tato mAmicCAptuM DanaYjaya..12.9..
aByAse'pyasamarTo'si matkarmaparamo Bava. madarTamapi karmARi kurvan sidDimavApsyasi..12.10..
aTEtadapyaSakto'si kartuM madyogamASritaH. sarvakarmaPalatyAgaM tataH kuru yatAtmavAn..12.11..
Sreyo hi jYAnamaByAsAjjYAnAdDyAnaM viSizyate. DyAnAtkarmaPalatyAgastyAgAcCAntiranantaram..12.12..
advezwA sarvaBUtAnAM mEtraH karuRa eva ca. nirmamo nirahaNkAraH samaduHKasuKaH kzamI..12.13..
santuzwaH satataM yogI yatAtmA dfQaniScayaH. mayyarpitamanobudDiryo madBaktaH sa me priyaH..12.14..
yasmAnnodvijate loko lokAnnodvijate ca yaH. harzAmarzaBayodvegErmukto yaH sa ca me priyaH..12.15..
anapekzaH Sucirdakza udAsIno gatavyaTaH. sarvAramBaparityAgI yo madBaktaH sa me priyaH..12.16..
yo na hfzyati na dvezwi na Socati na kANkzati. SuBASuBaparityAgI BaktimAnyaH sa me priyaH..12.17..
samaH SatrO ca mitre ca taTA mAnApamAnayoH. SItozRasuKaduHKezu samaH saNgavivarjitaH..12.18..
tulyanindAstutirmOnI santuzwo yenakenacit. aniketaH sTiramatirBaktimAnme priyo naraH..12.19..
ye tu DarmyAmftamidaM yaToktaM paryupAsate. SraddaDAnA matparamA BaktAste'tIva me priyAH..12.20..
